R1.defect: S_ISREG proves the opened thing is a file and not that it is THIS corner's file; a hard link is a second name for the inode, which O_NOFOLLOW and a confined pathname cannot see
change: the destination descriptor must be S_ISREG AND st_nlink == 1
a destination believed free is claimed with O_CREAT|O_EXCL rather than adopted with O_CREAT
a refusal keeps the existing bytes, declares the uncertainty and retains the source as its own generation
exactly ONE rotation, so a corner whose fresh name is also unusable stops rather than looping inside the provider's drain
_appended acquires the destination BEFORE positioning the source, because acquiring can rotate
R1.after: the reviewer's probe declares 'a retained native file is also linked elsewhere...', leaves the sibling and the alias byte-identical, and retains the source at s.jsonl%232

R2.defect: _walked skipped a SOURCE named .retention.json because the DESTINATION keeps its record under that name, so a real provider transcript was neither retained nor reported
change: _flat escapes a flattened name colliding with the record or its staging namespace: a leading . becomes %2E, in the same scheme that already escapes a literal per-cent as %25
_walked skips no source name at all
R2.after: .retention.json is retained as %2Eretention.json; .retention.json.1 as %2Eretention.json.1, resumed across a restart from its own record; a provider file really called %2Eretention.json becomes %252Eretention.json
R2.also_closed: those names were refused by _confined as record destinations, so before this even a retained one could never be resumed
